title: 1944 press reports of silver spheres over Germany

tellings.quote: there's a whole bunch of stories in 1944 Newsweek ran the silver sphere sp puzzle um Christmas day in 1944 Associated Press balls of silver scene over the German Reich intrigue science

plain: In 1944 the mainstream press reported strange silver balls in the skies over wartime Germany, says Marik von Rennenkampff, a writer who studies the history of UFO reports. He tells Michels, without pointing to a further source, that Newsweek ran a piece in 1944 called "The Silver Sphere Puzzle," and that on Christmas Day 1944 the Associated Press carried a story headlined "Balls of silver seen over the German Reich intrigue science." He brings them up as evidence that sightings of unexplained objects were in the news years before the UFO wave of the late 1940s.
